name: Aether
runtime: native WebView2 window (pywebview) — localhost only, no browser UI

models.note: Any Ollama model works. These are the defaults a fresh install starts with; the installer suggests others when the hardware calls for it, and models can be added or removed from inside Aether. Capabilities are read from Ollama's /api/show, not configured here.

roles.reasoning: the chat model, offered when it reports a thinking mode
roles.agentic: any model that reports tool calling
roles.computer_use: an agentic model that reports vision

context.note: The window belongs to the role, not the model, and a model can override it. Both are clamped to the model's native window and to what the card can hold.
context.reasoning_ceiling_note: Thinking fills KV fast enough that a model's native window is not a safe limit for it.
context.yarn_note: Qwen3-Coder supports YaRN to 1M in theory, but Ollama does not expose YaRN rope scaling. 1M is not practical on a 3090 Ti (24GB); use llama.cpp directly if you ever need it on much larger memory.

ollama_tuning.note: Unified memory is ON by default on Windows (WDDM). Linux needs GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1 on the ollama systemd unit so extra KV/context pages into RAM instead of OOM.
